introduction: NJ 211 offers resource referrals 24 hours a day through phone, text, chat and its website. Use it to identify local services when you do not know where to begin.
description: NJ 211 offers resource referrals 24 hours a day through phone, text, chat and its website. Use it to identify local services when you do not know where to begin.

sections.who: People seeking community-service information can contact the helpline. The referred provider applies its own eligibility and funding rules.
sections.get: Specialists locate services for needs including housing, food, healthcare and utilities. This is a referral service rather than approval of a cash or benefit application.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Choose a contact route

    Dial 211 or 877-652-1148, text your ZIP code to 898211, or use NJ 211 chat.

  2. Describe the situation

    Explain the type of help and your location so the specialist can identify appropriate providers.

  3. Follow up directly

    Ask each provider whether intake is open and what records it needs.
sections.after: Ask for another referral if an agency cannot help. Record the reason it was unsuitable so the specialist can narrow the next search.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NJ 211 contact options and service hours, Provider overview. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
